props.name: cancel
props.description: Shows the cancel action. Defaults to true for `confirm` and false otherwise.

props.name: center
props.description: Centers the icon, title, and description, and stretches the actions into an equal row.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the dialog content.

props.name: classes
props.description: Slot class defaults for this alert dialog.

props.name: close
props.description: Whether the corner close button is shown.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Whether an outside pointer press on the overlay dismisses the dialog.

props.name: danger
props.description: Styles the OK action as `destructive` when `okVariant` is omitted.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the type icon. `null` omits the icon.

props.name: id
props.description:
Selects this host from `AlertDialog.confirm(id, options)` and the other methods.
A call without an id uses the last mounted host. Unmounting the host settles its open dialogs as `false`.

props.name: okVariant
props.description: Visual treatment of the OK action.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the dialog content.

props.name: styles
props.description: Slot style defaults for this alert dialog.

props.name: subtle
props.description: Gives the footer a top border and muted background, like Card's `subtle` variant.
